problems.root_cause: discovery stores resolve_endpoint in 3 formats (6 absolute, 4 relative, 1 /dispatch) without normalizing; the shared helper asResolvePath returns absolute URLs; fixes patch call sites one at a time

principles: REGISTRATION is the list discovery actually ROUTES on; filtering the /shapes handler alone is inert (development-vessel src/index.ts:74)
An ungraded trace is not neutral: grade every trace (identity-vessel src/services/trace.ts, 2026-08-09)

Planner matches a goal to ANY advertised resolver from its description alone, with no hand-written per-resolver hint; a vessel-advertised description beats a learned one (discovery-vessel src/index.ts ~570-600)
Resolve through DISCOVERY, never activity-api (ribosome-vessel src/index.ts:117)
A consumer vessel owns no shapes (ribosome index.ts:697); discovery must accept consumers or fail loudly

Observed: every fix here patched one call site or one resolver and left the shared seam (registration normalization, one URL joiner, one trace schema with reasons) alone, so the same failure comes back under a different name

Measurement caveat: 'last 30 days' is unanswerable for failure reasons because the execution table keeps about 5 days and trace content keeps no errors; a store that keeps successes longer than failures cannot compound on failure
